programme.desc: Ava é uma assassina a soldo de uma organização secreta, que viaja por todo mundo com a missão de abater alvos VIP. Quando um desses trabalhos corre mal, Ava é obrigada a lutar pela sua sobrevivência e a enfrentar os fantasmas do passado

programme.title: O Corpo Da Mentira
programme.desc: Roger Ferris é um agente da CIA que descobre que um grande líder terrorista opera a partir da Jordânia. Quando concebe um plano para se infiltrar na sua rede, começa a questionar se os seus aliados não poderão interferir na operação e pôr a sua vida em risco.

programme.title: Homefront - A Última Defesa
programme.desc: Um ex-agente do departamento de combate à droga muda-se com a filha para uma pequena cidade rural em busca de uma vida tranquila. Quando um conflito escolar expõe o seu passado, ele atrai a atenção de um perigoso traficante local que ameaça a sua família.

programme.title: Tom Of Finland
programme.desc: A vida e obra do artista finlandês Touko Valio Laaksonen, mais conhecido como Tom of Finland, uma das figuras mais influentes e celebradas da cultura gay do século XX, desde o seu regresso a casa após lutar na Segunda Guerra Mundial até à sua consagração por via dos seus desenhos homoeróticos.

programme.title: A Melhor História De Paulo Coelho
programme.desc: Com base em depoimentos do próprio Paulo Coelho, o filme conta a história dos momentos mais marcantes da vida do escritor, como os traumas, a relação com as drogas e a religião, a sexualidade e a parceria com o músico Raul Seixas.

programme.title: Os Medos De Rain
programme.desc: Uma rapariga que vive com esquizofrenia luta com alucinações terríveis quando começa a suspeitar que o seu vizinho sequestrou uma criança. A única pessoa que acredita nela é Caleb, um miúdo que ela nem tem a certeza de que existe.

programme.title: Todo O Dinheiro Do Mundo
programme.desc: Quando o neto de 16 anos do homem mais rico do mundo, John Paul Getty, é raptado, a família recebe um pedido de resgate exorbitante, que o milionário se recusa a pagar. Com a vida do filho em jogo, Gail alia-se ao braço direito de Getty para tentar resolver a situação.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: Esta é a história do ataque terrorista ao luxuoso Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, em Bombaim, no ano de 2008. No meio do caos, os funcionários do hotel arriscam a vida para manterem todos a salvo e fazem sacrifícios impensáveis para se protegerem a si e às suas famílias.

programme.title: À Deriva
programme.desc: Quando Tami e Richard, um casal de ávidos velejadores, se aventuram numa viagem pelo oceano, são atingidos por um furacão devastador. Após a tempestade, ela encontra-o gravemente ferido e o barco quase destruído, e vai ter de encontrar as forças necessárias para os salvar.

programme.title: First Kill Caça Ao Homem
programme.desc: Will Beeman é um bem sucedido profissional de Wall Street cujo filho é raptado. Para resgatar o rapaz, ele terá ajudar o raptor a recuperar a chave que dá acesso ao dinheiro roubado num banco, sempre perseguido pelo chefe da polícia Marvin Howell.

programme.title: Assalto Ao Shopping
programme.desc: Eddie Deacon é um ex-militar que só consegue arranjar emprego como segurança de supermercado. Logo na primeira noite, tem de proteger uma menina que é atacada por mercenários profissionais para a impedirem de testemunhar contra eles.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola 2
programme.desc: Com a missão de recuperar informação sensível que foi roubada, um agente do FBI com mau feitio faz-se passar por professor do jardim de infância, mas o ambiente liberal e politicamente correto da escola torna-se cada vez mais insuportável para ele.

programme.title: Utoya, 22 De Julho
programme.desc: Uma rapariga adolescente tenta sobreviver e encontrar a irmã mais nova durante o massacre de 22 de Julho de 2011 na ilha norueguesa de Utoya, quando um terrorista de extrema-direita atirou a matar às centenas jovens que ali participavam num campo de férias político.

programme.title: Os Miseráveis
programme.desc: Stéphane é um polícia que se muda da província para os subúrbios de Paris, onde se junta à Brigada Anti-Crime e descobre rapidamente o clima de extrema tensão que existe entre os diferentes gangues locais e as forças da ordem.

programme.title: Hell Or High Water - Custe O Que Custar
programme.desc: Um pai divorciado e seu irmão mais velho, um ex-condenado, recorrem a um plano desesperado de assalto a bancos para salvar a fazenda da sua família no Oeste do Texas.

programme.title: O Assassinato De Nicole Brown Simpson
programme.desc: Vinte e cinco anos após a morte de Nicole Brown Simpson, este thriller explora os dias que antecederam o assassinato, com uma nova tese sobre o autor do crime, que se afasta do ex-marido O. J. Simpson e envolve o serial-killer Glen Rogers.

programme.title: K.o.
programme.desc: Antoine Lecomte, um homem frio e arrogante, é o diretor executivo de um canal televisivo. Um dia, ao despertar do estado de coma, descobre que a sua vida mudou e nada parece ser como ele recordava mas será tudo uma realidade ou apenas um sonho

programme.title: Os Camarões Brilhantes
programme.desc: Após proferir declarações homofóbicas na televisão, Matthias Le Goff, um campeão olímpico em final de carreira, vê-se forçado a treinar os Camarões Brilhantes, uma equipa gay de polo aquático, que se quer apurar para os Jogos Gay da Croácia, onde competem os atletas mais sexy da comunidade LGBT.

programme.title: Rogue Warfare A Caçada
programme.desc: Cumprindo ordens diretas do Presidente dos EUA, uma equipa de soldados de elite tem de atravessar as linhas do inimigo para libertar o seu líder, que foi capturado por terroristas.

programme.title: Ice Merchants
programme.desc: Um homem e o seu filho saltam de paraquedas todos os dias, da sua casa fria e vertiginosa presa no alto de um precipício, para se deslocarem à aldeia que se situa na planície abaixo, onde vendem o gelo que produzem durante a noite.

programme.title: Um Herói
programme.desc: Rahim encontra-se preso devido a uma dívida que não conseguiu pagar. Durante uma saída precária de dois dias, tenta convencer o seu credor a perdoar-lhe uma parte da quantia, mas as coisas não correm como esperado.

programme.title: Xixi, Cama
programme.desc: Antoine é um solteirão, folião e sedutor, que tem de encontrar um novo companheiro com quem dividir as despesas do seu incrível apartamento em Paris. Aceita a proposta de Jeanne, 1m70, olhos azuis, mas só depois é que percebe que ela vem com duas crianças, que lhe vão fazer a vida negra.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola 2
programme.desc: Com a missão de recuperar informação sensível que foi roubada, um agente do FBI com mau feitio faz-se passar por professor do jardim de infância, mas o ambiente liberal e politicamente correto da escola torna-se cada vez mais insuportável para ele.

programme.title: A Armadilha
programme.desc: Virginia Gin Baker é uma investigadora de uma empresa de seguros enviada para perseguir e ajudar a capturar Robert MacDougal, um ladrão profissional especializado em arte.

programme.title: Sem Hora Marcada
programme.desc: Uma jovem a tirar fotografias na natureza testemunha sem querer o assassínio de um traficante por uma polícia e vê-se envolvida numa conspiração que envolve agentes corruptos. Em fuga pela vida, a única pessoa que lhe pode valer é um velho oficial reformado.

programme.title: As Aventuras Do Dr. Dolittle
programme.desc: John Dolittle é um médico que consegue falar com animais e se lança numa aventura para encontrar uma ilha lendária com um jovem aprendiz e uma tripulações de estranha bicharada.

programme.title: 21 Pontes
programme.desc: Andre Davis é um detetive da polícia de Nova Iorque que tem de capturar os responsáveis pelas mortes de vários colegas, numa operação-limite onde são fechadas as 21 pontes de Manhattan para impedir a fuga dos assassinos da ilha.

programme.title: Mad Max - As Motos Da Morte
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo e apocalíptico, Mad Max Rockatansky, um destemido polícia vestido de cabedal, declara guerra aos assassinos motorizados que apontaram armas à sua família.

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Atena
programme.desc: Atena foi abusada pelo pai durante a infância. Como ele desapareceu, ela faz hoje justiça pelas próprias mãos em casos semelhantes que ocorrem na sua cidade brasileira. Com a ajuda do jornalista Carlos, Atena encontra o pai em Montevideu e não vai descansar enquanto não se vingar.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Bacchetti performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in this concert recorded at Teatro Chiabrera in the Italian city of Savona. He is accompanied by I Musici di Parma. On the program are J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in E major, BWV 878 (The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, No. 9), Joseph Haydn's Piano Concerto No. 11 in D major (Hob.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the “Giuseppe Nicolini,” Conservatory of Piacenza, and the “Giuseppe Verdi,” Conservatory of Milan, as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme”. On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. His Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the famous trilogy by writer J. R. R Tolkien.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Romeo And Juliet - Fantasy Ouverture
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 And Dvorák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 4 BWV 1017
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 1 BWV 1014 is the fourth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Composed between 1901 and 1902, Mahler's Fifth Symphony marked a significant shift in his compositional style, moving away from vocal elements toward a purely symphonic structure. It's a work of immense scope and emotional depth, known for its rich orchestral textures and intricate counterpoint.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 6, Op. 18 No. 6
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Brahms Tragic Overture And Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the miracle play 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' (c. 1515). Over five centuries, this old story hasn’t lost a bit of its power and is unquestionably part of the canon of Dutch culture. In this opera, we follow the curious but vulnerable Mariken on a journey through a dark world.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture.

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace III
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), III’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and sho, a Japanese free-reed mouth organ, played here by Naomi Sato. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music. This performance was recorded at Chiesa di San Cristo in Brescia, Italy.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006.

programme.title: Ravel by Cherkaoui/Verbruggen
programme.desc: The Royal Ballet Flanders performs a beautiful program with ballets by choreographers Sidi Larbi Cherkaoui and Jeroen Verbruggen. The Symphonic Orchestra of the Opera Vlaanderen is conducted by Yannis Pouspourikas. Ravel remains a source of inspiration for many choreographers. Cherkaoui and rising talent Verbruggen take their vision of Ravel's music to the stage with the Ballet Flanders.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.

programme.title: Galaxymphony Strikes Back
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Rodrigo - Concierto de Aranjuez
programme.desc: Juan Manuel Cañizares is the soloist in a performance of Joaquín Rodrigo's (1901-1999) Concierto de Aranjuez. He is accompanied by the Berliner Philharmoniker led by maestro Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva’ Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann’s only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Mahler - The Song of Lamentation
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería and four vocal soloists in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s cantata ‘The Song of Lamentation’ (Das klagende Lied). Among the soloists are soprano Sally Dibblee, mezzo-soprano Marjorie Elinor Dix, tenor Arturo Chacón, and bass Stephen West.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.desc: O programa Som do Monte semanalmente, apresentado por Frei Gilson, religioso do instituto Carmelitas Mensageiros do Espírito Santo. O programa tem como foco levar uma espiritualidade profunda e radical, através de fontes arraigadas à tradição da Igreja, vida dos santos, catecismo e palavra de Deus. Tudo isso somado a musicalidade e carisma próprio do Frei Gilson.

programme.desc: O Prof. Felipe Aquino aborda os principais acontecimentos do mundo e o porquê do posicionamento da Igreja mediante cada facto, sempre entrevistando grandes estudiosos cristãos.

programme.title: Fazendo Esperança

programme.desc: A Fundação Ajuda a Igreja que Sofre traz-nos as realidades externas, principalmente, as notícias do Médio Oriente.

Sempre sob o ponto de vista de vários profissionais, que trazem as melhores dicas para estimular um estilo de vida mais saudável, favorecendo o cuidado com o nosso corpo, templo do Espírito Santo.

programme.title: O Poder Da Palavra - 1ª Exibição

Na leitura da Palavra de Deus temos a oportunidade de sermos curados e restaurados. Na Palavra, Deus fala connosco e nos comunica Sua Sabedoria.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Michael e Maria Start restauram um jogo de arcada de futebol dos anos 50. Michael trabalha na mecânica e Maria as camisolas para todos os jogadores.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Rebecca Pritchard confia a sua herança, uma estátua de querubim carinhosamente conhecida como Fat Les, ao escultor Nick Elphick, que a deve restaurar.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T7 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A primeira refeição de um sobrevivente pode ser a última quando bactérias o atingem gravemente. A queimadura num pé leva um veterano XL ao limite e 2 sobreviventes são eliminados.

programme.title: Camionistas Da Alemanha T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Ser camionista é difícil: muitas horas, cargas enormes e estradas movimentadas. Camionistas da Alemanha, Itália e Holanda contam as suas viagens.

programme.title: Camionistas Da Alemanha T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Ser camionista é difícil: muitas horas, cargas enormes e estradas movimentadas. Camionistas da Alemanha, Itália e Holanda contam as suas viagens.

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T11 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Como é que forjam o aço para fazerem um carro mais leve, mais ecológico e mais seguro? E como é que tosquiam os 80 milhões de carneiros australianos todos os anos?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Como é que os ilhéus das Hébridas Exteriores usam a energia do pedal para tecer o famoso tweed Harris? E, na Islândia, como é que se prepara tubarão fermentado?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Como se fazem as camas mais caras e luxuosas do mundo? E como se enviam mantimentos e equipamento para a Estação Espacial Internacional?

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T14 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Mike encontra um Lancia Fúlvia de 1972 raro. Ele e Ant têm que arranjar as juntas homocinéticas, um radiador avariado, um painel partido e um sistema de combustível entupido.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T14 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Mike e Ant levam um Datsun 510 de 2 portas de 1972 até ao século XXI. O motor está em boas condições, mas a pintura, a caixa de velocidades e a carroçaria deixam-no ficar mal.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Condições voláteis fora da gigante mina de Porgera leva Parker e a equipa a explorar as vilas próximas. Eles testemunham as técnicas locais ilegais usadas para procurar ouro.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Depois de ter enfrentados os hostis trilhos de Klondike e as hostis florestas da Guiana, Parker Schnabel leva a sua caça ao ouro ao próximo nível na Papua Nova Guiné.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Na propriedade, Otto e Charlotte continuam a restauração da cabana do estrume - mas estará ele a esforçar-se demasiado e a arriscar magoar a hérnia?

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Constantemente levados ao limite pelos elementos, pelas circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilchers continuam a trabalhar juntos como família para sustentar o seu rico legado.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T10 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os mineiros do Yukon estão de volta para arriscar tudo na esperança de fazer fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia está mais alta que nunca!

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T10 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os mineiros do Yukon estão de volta para arriscar tudo na esperança de fazer fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia está mais alta que nunca!

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Como se faz o famosos chapéu Borsalino, usado pelo Indiana Jones? E como se faz uma bicicleta dobrável até ao décimo do tamanho de uma bicicleta normal?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Como é que fazem a guitarra elétrica mais famosa do mundo, a Fender Stratocaster? E como se faz o caviar de ovas fermentadas suecas da Kalle?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Tem estado inclinada há mais de 800 anos - qual é a magia que desafia a gravidade por detrás da Torre de Pizza? E como são feitas as bolachas digestivas de chocolate?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Como é que os gregos da antiguidade inventaram o pergaminho com técnicas que ainda se usam hoje? E como se fazem os volantes, o objeto mais rápido do desporto?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Como se fazem as canetas mais suaves que não borram ou desaparecem? E como fazem pizza para os soldados na frente de combate?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Em Cremona, como fazem violinos modernos que soam tão bem quanto os lendários Stradivarius? E como se constroem casas com pedra vulcânica?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Como é que uma empresa holandesa faz os iates mais rápidos do mundo? E como se fazem os novos fatos espaciais que pesam e custam um quinto dos anteriores?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Como se faz o presunto de Parma, o mais famoso do mundo? Como se fazem máquinas de remo e como é feita a icónica sinalética do metro de Londres?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Como é que os aviões partem e aterram na praia num dos aeroportos mais velhos do mundo? E como é que se faz à mão o vestido nacional da Baviera, o lederhosen?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T11 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Como é que o mantém confortável, entretido e em segurança com os mais recentes assentos de avião? Como é que criam os soutiens com tecnologia aeroespacial para uma elevação extra?

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T4 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: O Dr. Pinball, especialista em jogos de árcade, restaura um raro jogo de basquetebol americano dos anos 40. O artista, Nick, aplica reboco e tinta a um enorme touro vintage.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard pede a Steve Norman para salvar uma mesa de pau-rosa muito rara e valiosa, com métodos tradicionais de corte de latão.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Mark Squires repara e reconstrói um jogo de bandidos armados dos anos 60. Ted Edley tem a tarefa de restaurar uma lanterna de boia enferrujada.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T9 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O acampamento recentemente comprado por um casal é totalmente inabitável. Querem uma casa perto de água, muitas janelas e espaço para grandes convívios.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T9 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: O marido de uma mulher faleceu antes de terminar a sua cabana para a família. Chase e a equipa juntam-se a alguns amigos verdes para terminar o que ele começou.

programme.title: Caçadores De Fantasmas T15 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A equipa investiga estranhos fenómenos num parque de diversões em Turner, Oregon. Zak acredita que uma energia residual pode ser responsável por isso.

programme.title: Expedição X T4 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Diz-se que um monstro assassino se esconde nos pântanos perto de Nova Orleães. Phil e Jess investigam a fera sanguinária que aterroriza o Bayou.

programme.title: Expedição X T4 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Phil e Jess exploram uma cidade mineira de ouro abandonada. Ao seguirem por abandonadas da cidade, descobrem os seus segredos sangrentos.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Deep T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade explora um navio naufragado que podia ter carregado o tesouro nazi roubado. Filmagens captam o momento em que um navio de carga moderno se partiu em dois no Mar Negro.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Deep T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade explora os segredos obscuros de um naufrágio de 150 anos ao largo da costa mexicana. Depois, descobre um «rio que ferve» escondido nas profundezas da Amazónia.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T7 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Waz resiste no seu primeiro dia na selva sozinho, enquanto Steven luta contra a descida da temperatura. Além disso, outra tempestade implacável põe à prova os sobreviventes.

programme.title: Camionistas Da Alemanha T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Ser camionista é difícil: muitas horas, cargas enormes e estradas movimentadas. Camionistas da Alemanha, Itália e Holanda contam as suas viagens.

programme.desc: Mike encontra um dos 1000 MC40s alguma vez feitos, uma homenagem aos 40 anos da vitória do ícone britânico, vencedor do rally de Monte Carlo.

programme.desc: Mike procura um SUV - um Internacional Harvester Scout 800A de 1970. A reparação de Ant inclui reconstruir uma caixa de transmissão defeituosa e substituir o interior.

programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 86
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 68
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 29
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 69
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 88
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Duke Ellington live at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: Duke Ellington: Live in '58 features the earliest-known filmed full-length concert by one of the 20th Century's greatest songwriters and bandleaders. Filmed at Amsterdam's famed Concertgebouw, this 80-minute concert features the 16-piece Duke Ellington Orchestra two years after their stunning performance at the 1956 Newport Jazz Festival, which Duke considered his second birth.

programme.title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Peter Beets: Chopin meets the Blues
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Live in London
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, 'The Best Is Yet To Come,' 'Fly Me to the Moon,' and his signature song 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.'.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk - Well You Needn't
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Sly
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: 29th Street Saxophone Quartet: Estival 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Duets: Carla Bley and Steve Swallow in 1988
programme.desc: If any two musicians share a special bond when they perform, it’s pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the 1960s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. A glance or a smile?seems to change the feel of the music.

programme.title: Carrie Smith
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Omar Sosa AfroCubano Quarteto
programme.desc: To call Omar Sosa an Afro-Cuban jazz pianist would only capture part of his true style. Because while he has always kept one foot firmly within the traditions of his native isle, this citizen of the world also shows an insatiable curiosity, tirelessly exploring music from around the world: from the Caribbean to India and from West Africa to the Arab World. Nothing seems to escape his thirst for discovery.

programme.title: Mondriaan Jazz 2017: FORQ
programme.desc: Forq is an instrumental quartet with an aggressive sound and a penchant for sonic exploration. Originally founded by keyboardist?Henry Hey?(David Bowie, Empire of the Sun, and Jeff 'Tain' Watts) and bassist?Michael League?(Grammy-winning founder of Snarky Puppy), Forq is joined by guitarist?Chris McQueen?and drummer?Jason 'JT' Thomas.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Chain Reaction
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Jacob Karlzon Trio - Open Waters
programme.desc: Swedish pianist Jacob Karlzon is joined by Danish bassist Morten Ramsbøl and Swedish drummer Rasmus Kihlberg at the Steinway piano factory in Hamburg to present their album ‘Open Waters’. Karlzon, a classically trained pianist who shared a stage with Kenny Wheeler, Norma Winstone, and Billy Cobham keeps the rich tradition of Swedish jazz eclecticism alive.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: The Flying Pickets - Don't Turn Around
programme.desc: The Flying Pickets are a British vocal group that was formed in 1982, transferring the art of a cappella to the pop music scene. These five gentlemen scored a number one hit in 1983 in the UK Singles Chart with their version of 'Only You'. Performing live in Stuttgart, vocalists Hereward Kaye, Gary Howard, Michael Henry, Nick Godfrey and Ricky Payne have many surprises in store for their appreciative audience.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sienna Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: John Lurie: A Lounge Lizard Alone
programme.desc: In 1978, John Lurie formed The Lounge Lizards jazz ensemble with his brother Evan; the pair played music together for 20 years. However, in this New Year's Eve performance, Lurie (saxophone) plays a legendary show with drummer Larry Wright. Lurie is a musician, actor, painter, and the driving force behind the Strange And Beautiful music label.

programme.title: Maybe this time
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect.

programme.title: Free Improvisation 3
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra: Changing Faces
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: Tribute to Monk
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report’s “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: New Cool Collective - Melkweg, Amsterdam
programme.desc: New Cool Collective is one of the foremost Dutch jazz ensembles. Pioneering new blends of music styles since 1993, NCC has performed in various formations, from small combos to larger ensembles and even big bands! The ensemble’s high energy is cut out for the dance floors, as dance, Latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo all meet in a jazzy mix.

programme.title: 'Long Tall Dexter' Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64?features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2018, English trip-hop group Morcheeba performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Vein ft. Greg Osby
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Patáx: A Night to Remember 1/2
programme.desc: Patáx was heavily influenced by seminal fusion bands like Weather Report and Return to Forever. Don’t mistake this Spanish powerhouse for a carbon copy of either, however, as Patáx presents an accomplished mix of styles, including soul, jazz, funk and hip-hop. The group is led by the passionate Spanish-American percussionist Jorge Perez, who draws his musical influence from both sides of the Atlantic.

programme.title: Chick Corea Elektric Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Thalma de Freitas
programme.desc: Thalma de Freitas is a Brazilian singer, songwriter, and actress from Rio de Janeiro. Daughter of the renowned pianist Laércio de Freitas, her work is a masterful fusion of MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), jazz, and Afro-Brazilian influences. In 2019, her album ‘Sorte!’ was nominated for a Grammy Award. For this intimate performance, she is joined by guitarist Helô Ferreira.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.desc: The IBO Super Welterweight World Championship is on the line when champion Uisma Lima of Portugal defends against undefeated Shervantaigh Koopman at the Emperors Palace in Kempton Park, South Africa. programme.title: Lactu 360 Le Journal

programme.title: Vapeur
programme.desc: Le détective privé Goro est venu à Sakurajima, une île-volcan du sud du Japon, à la recherche d’une personne disparue ou, comme le disent les Japonais, quelqu’un qui s’est « évaporé ». Au cours de son enquête, il croise la route de trois amies : Toshie, Moe et Mayumi. Elles s’intéressent à lui comme à tout ce qui est nouveau sur l’île. Goro semble alors oublier sa mission.

programme.title: A l'instinct
programme.desc: Après les évènements de Nantes, le capitaine Téva Royer rencontre la commandante spéciale Oriane Girard. Il l'accompagne désormais dans les affaires singulières et mystérieuses qu'elle est chargée d'élucider. Leur première scène de crime remue de douloureux souvenirs dans le petit village de Saint-Avène.

programme.title: Le Livreur de Noël
programme.desc: Tandis qu’il attend l’arrivée de ses enfants pour fêter Noël, Julien, en CDD dans une entreprise de livraisons est contraint d’accepter un remplacement au dernier moment. Il promet à ses enfants de rentrer avant minuit et les confie à sa fantasque voisine Olga ! Entre une mauvaise fréquentation du passé qui ressurgit et des livraisons inattendues... le père de famille débute une tournée riche en aventures.

programme.title: Un Dimanche à la Campagne
programme.desc: Le rendez-vous de rencontre à la fois détonante et pleine d'émotions présenté par Frédéric Lopez. Chaque dimanche, il reçoit ses invités à la campagne. Quelque part loin du tumulte, ils se retrouvent le temps d’un week-end. Un moment hors du temps pour se rencontrer et pour parler d’amour, d’amitié, de la vie.

programme.title: Carte Blanche à Passi

programme.title: C'est toujours pas Sorcier
programme.desc: La Brigade des sapeurs-pompiers de Paris se rend sur les lieux d'incendies d'immeubles et d'une raffinerie. Il s'agit de comprendre comment se déclarent les incendies et surtout comment les éteindre. A quelle température un solide, un liquide ou un gaz devient-il inflammable ? Pourquoi l'eau éteint-elle certains feux et pas d'autres ? Comment les pompiers se protègent-ils des fortes températures et des flammes ?

programme.title: Versailles est en Fête
programme.desc: Animé par Stéphane Bern Réalisation : François Goetghebeur Direction artistique : Kamel Ouali Programmation : Emmanuel Virot Production : Electron Libre Productions (groupe Mediawan) En co-production avec Opéra Royal / Château de Versailles Spectacles Pour la première fois, le plus célèbre château de France devient le théâtre d’un immense spectacle où patrimoine, musique et création contemporaine dialoguent dans un écrin d’exception.

programme.title: Les Trésors du Paris Haussmannien
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par Martange Production, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2022. Réalisatrice : Florence Troquereau Présentation : Sophie Jovillard. Décembre 1851 : la France vient de vivre un coup d'État qui restaure le système impérial. S'ouvre alors le Second Empire. Louis Napoléon Bonaparte veut faire de sa capitale la plus belle. En à peine deux décennies, il va mener à bien un ambitieux plan de rénovation.

programme.title: La Réunification des 2 Corées
programme.desc: Création théâtrale : Joël Pommerat Avec Ella Benoit, Saadia Bentaïeb, Yannick Choirat, Philippe Frécon, Ruth Olaizola, Marie Piemontese, Anne Rotger, David Sighicelli, Maxime Tshibangu (et Agnès Berthon) Chef-d’œuvre de Joël Pommerat, La Réunification des deux Corées est une puissante traversée de l’amour, entre réalisme et humour, une radiographie des passions de tous les temps dans une mise en scène inoubliable.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez Dirige Stravinsky - l'oiseau de Feu au louvre
programme.desc: Co-production: Idéale Audience And le Musée du Louvre Réalisation: Andy Sommer Capté au Musée du Louvre de Paris en décembre 2008 Le compositeur et chef d’orchestre Pierre Boulez est particulièrement connu pour ses interprétations raffinées des classiques du XXe siècle en général et de Stravinsky en particulier.

programme.title: Birds on a Wire - le Chant des Oiseaux (À la Philharmonie de...
programme.desc: Réalisation : Jeremiah Production : La Familia Production déléguée : Oléo Films Avec le soutien du Centre national de la musique Le duo formé par Rosemary Standley et Dom La Nena fête ses dix ans avec un mélange de leurs chansons signature et de nouvelles reprises, pour certaines dans une version avec chœur de jeunes filles.

programme.title: Les deux Canards
programme.desc: Produit par la compagnie des Indes Réalisateur : Patrick Czaplinski Une pièce de Tristan Bernard et Alfred Athis Mise en scène : Corinne Jahier et Alain Sachs Avec Isabelle Nanty, Yvan Le Bolloc'h Gélidon, écrivain parisien et raffiné, lors d’un voyage en province, tombe sous le charme de Léontine, la voluptueuse et impétueuse épouse de l’imprimeur.

programme.title: Le Refuge
programme.desc: Réalisé par François Ozon Avec Isabelle Carré, Louis-Ronan Choisy, Melvin Poupaud Mousse et Louis sont beaux, riches et jeunes, mais la drogue fait partie de leur vie. Un jour, Louis meurt et Mousse apprend qu'elle est enceinte.

programme.title: En Concert Privé avec Vanessa Paradis
programme.desc: Productrice Panthéon Films : Naëlle Samri Producteur Bangumi : Laurent Bon Producteur éditorial Bangumi : Julien Beau Productrice exécutive Bangumi : Perrine Altman Perrin Production : Panthéon Films / Bangumi Réalisation : Julien Peultier Après sept années de silence discographique, Vanessa Paradis a signé son grand retour en octobre 2025 avec un album lumineux, « Le retour des beaux jours ».

programme.title: Normal
programme.desc: Coproduction : Bonne Pioche Télévision et Acte 2 Réalisé par Julien Condemine Capté au Cado, Orléans Texte : Jane Anderson Traduction et adaptation : Julie Delarme et Emmanuel Suarez Mise en scène : Julie Delarme Avec Lionel Abelanski, Vincent Deniard, Colombe Ducrot, Jérémy Gillet, Guilaine Londez, Jacques Develay et la participation amicale d’Hélène Vincent. Sam et Irma s’aiment depuis 25 ans.

programme.title: Ring
programme.desc: Une pièce de Léonore Confino Mise en scène Côme de Bellescize Avec Jina Djemba et Amaury de Crayencour Dans un corps-à-corps jubilatoire, Jina Djemba et Amaury de Crayencour nous emmènent dans un voyage poignant et hilarant au pays du couple. De la première rencontre à la dernière rupture, seize rounds amoureux qui oscillent nerveusement entre rire et drame. Amants, parents, étrangers, divorcés, veufs, maris et femmes ...

programme.title: Avril Lavigne au Main Square Festival
programme.desc: Tourné le 7 juillet 2024 au Main Square festival Production : Neutra Production Réalisation : Alexandre Buisson Icône pop-punk incontournable, Avril Lavigne signe son grand retour sur scène avec une performance remarquée au Main Square Festival. L'artiste a enflammé le Main Square Festival avec un concert aussi énergique que nostalgique.

programme.title: Vladimir Cauchemar aux Francofolies de la Rochelle
programme.desc: Production : Morgane Production Réalisation : Julien Faustino Maître des platines et du beat, Vladimir Cauchemar est le grand gagnant de notre époque. Il revêt un crâne humain plus vrai que nature sur lequel est tatoué un coeur. Entre des titres pur rap, et des production électroniques, Vladimir Cauchemar n'est jamais contre un peu de folie et c’est avec son style unique qu’il a fait trembler les Francofolies.

programme.title: De la Rue aux Jeux
programme.desc: Production: Axe Sud - Marie-Pierre Bousquet Réalisation: Mohamed Athamna Capté au Centre culturel Aragon (Oyonnax) le 4 avril 2024 En se fondant sur le parcours incroyable du Pockemon Crew – compagnie de breakdance la plus titrée au monde –, Riyad Fghani souhaite retracer le chemin de toute une discipline, forgée dans et par la rue.

programme.desc: Documentaire produit par 17 Juin Media avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2025. Réalisation : Adélie Floch. programme.title: L' Australie Vue du Ciel
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par TVF International. 2023. Réalisation : Drew McPherson. Cette série propose une découverte de l’Australie à travers des prise de vue aériennes. Cet épisode propose une découverte de la Grande barrière de Corail vue du ciel. Située au nord-est de l’Australie, cette merveille de la nature s’étend sur plus de 2300 kilomètres au large du Queensland.

programme.title: Enquête de Santé
programme.desc: Réalisation : Marie-Agnès Suquet Production : 17 Juin Media avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2026 Près d’un Français sur 5 est en situation d’obésité. Longtemps réduite à une question de volonté, l’obésité est en réalité une maladie chronique, complexe, encore mal comprise et trop souvent stigmatisée. L’arrivée des nouveaux médicaments anti-obésité aux résultats spectaculaires fait naître un espoir immense.

programme.desc: Alguns templos sagrados foram construídos por cima das ruínas de estruturas que são muito mais antigas. O que levou os primeiros humanos a reconstruir nos mesmos sítios uma e outra vez?.

programme.title: Alienígenas T10 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: O sítio arqueológico de Göbekli Tepe, na Turquia, desafia tudo aquilo em que os arqueólogos modernos acreditam sobre o nosso passado. O complexo megalítico foi construído há mais de 12 mil anos.
